agent_explanation: The controller clamps force at fmax during cruise (steps 13-15 report exactly 11.515) but the clamp is missing on the close-to-waypoint branch. When the body approaches within ~1-1.6 of the waypoint at (11.5,11) at step 16, it switches to an unclamped arrival/hold law (large kp-driven command ~278, 24x fmax), violating the limit. Moving the waypoint far away keeps the controller in the clamped cruise branch and the violation disappears.
